issue_context.title: Date fields with custom formats are filled with a value but the input display something else
issue_context.body:
Hi pdfjs team,

Please find attach a really simple pdf file to reproduce the issue.
[Date.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/8242310/Date.pdf)
This pdf contains 4 date fields, One with a default format (dd/mm/yyyy) and the 3 others with custom formats:

    -  dd
    -  mm
    -  yyyy

The expected behavior is that whenever I fill dd field with 16 for instance, then when i focus out that field the value displayed is 16 but I get 01.

This happens for dd field and mm but it's working fine for dd/mm/yyyy and yyyy fields.

The initial values of the pdf are properly displayed, this happens only if I focus one of those fields.

Thank you for your time

Best regards.
comments: *For future reference;* When opening an issue, please provide *all* of the information requested in https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE.md such that all necessary details are provided.

It's mainly due to:
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/90c5e9882bfaafbc7532fdd04c172d65b6757399/src/scripting_api/aform.js#L56
when the argument is for example "05".
In Firefox, the result is `NaN` when in QuickJS it's interpreted as 0005/01/01 (it's why with QuickJS we can see a "01"), and in Chrome it corresponds to "2001/05/01".
So to fix the issue, we must try to use `scand` and then if something is wrong try to use `Date.parse`.
Fixed by the PR above. Thank you for reporting this!

Hello,

Thank you for your support and your reactivity !

review_comments: Are these default values changed to match the Adobe JS specification, or simply to match the implementation in Adobe Reader?
I opened the pdf from the issue in Acrobat and the UI for the date selection is set to January 2000 for the day field and to the 1st of December 2000 for the month field.
